items.stem: An outcome reads 'Students will watch three videos'. Why is this a weak learning outcome?

options.text: It describes an activity, not measurable learning
options.rationale: Correct: outcomes should state what the learner can do, not an activity performed.
The count is not the problem.

items.stem: Which TWO checks confirm constructive alignment in a course? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Every outcome has content that teaches it
Every outcome has an assessment that measures it
options.rationale: Correct: outcomes must also be assessed.

options.text: Every lesson has the same length
options.rationale: Equal length is unrelated to alignment.
Hiding outcomes does not aid alignment.
